description:
The workflow main goal is to check the quality of input fastq files after sequencing and demultiplexing.
Optionaly it can check for most abundant adaptor sequences.
It can also merge fastq files belonging from the same samples after resequencing prior to quality check.
The workflow was designed to be run in the SeqUIa (http://cfb.ceitec.muni.cz/sequia) application.
name: Raw fastq QC
